products.name: Trouble (Sold Out)
products.description: TROUBLE IS SOLD OUT. THANK YOU!! 😁❤️ You are buying the BLANK doll kit only. Photos of prototypes are examples only. I’m am so excited to introduce you to Trouble!! Why the name, I hear you ask? Well, this little one has been an adventure right from the word go! I could not for the life of me get the nose to work, so I started again. Then she decided to take up diving and fell off the stand and completely squishing her lips and nose. Once she was fixed, I left her on the table, only for me to come back to a massive gouge in her mouth (from what I have no idea 😂 ) I fix her again and knock her nose in the process. For the life of me, I could not get the nose to look how I wanted after that! So I just chopped it off and started again (again) 😂 🙈 Then just when I finally think she is getting somewhere and is almost ready to bake, I drop her on the edge of table!! 😩 🙈 A troubled birth, but I’m so happy with how she (or he) has turned out! Worth the constant battle.
